name: company-plugin
description: Shared 'how we work' layer for CXLWorkshops: bundled reference frameworks (GEO, content recycling, B2B funnels), automatic daily-log hooks (session-start continuity, session-end summarization), and a /team-update command that turns your daily logs into a team-updates/ PR for admin review. agents/ and skills/ are placeholders for now. Installed once, available in every <team>-os repo.
